scope: Single-repeat matrix-free headroom screen of established fixed-landmark block corrections; no adaptive landmarks or novelty claim

protocol.uniform: without replacement inside each block, fresh block draws
protocol.greedy: one-shot top current residual squared / original Schur diagonal; no sequential prefitting
protocol.momentum: exact energy minimization in current block correction and previous combined displacement; normalized2x2 Gram, numerical dependence truncation only
protocol.joint_history: project previous pair against coordinate block with existing Cholesky, optional local reorthogonalization, denominator h^T Sh; exact minimization in all16 coordinates plus previous displacement, no extra kernel query
protocol.feasibility: two_direction baseline generally violates selected residual zeros and cannot support unchanged-iterate landmark swaps; joint_history enforces selected residual and old-displacement orthogonality
protocol.coordinate_cpu_screen: min(8,max(1,2*fastest converged stronger scalar CPU seconds)) per variant, after setup; timeouts are censored cost screens
protocol.scalar_controls: power2/4/8 at rank16 and larger rank under explicit coarse/history/column-work allowance, not claimed exact total-peak match
protocol.execution_order: per case: larger scalar controls, coordinate variants, rank16 scalar controls; expensive same-rank baselines cannot prevent the coordinate comparison on the current case
